div.head: II As 14.1
div.ab: ⁊ gif se mynetere fúl wurðe, slea mon of þa hond, ðe he ðæt fúl mid worhte, ⁊ sette up on ða mynetsmiððan; ⁊ gif hit þonne tyhtle sy, ⁊ he hine ladian wille, ðonne ga he to þam hatum isene, ⁊ ladige þa hond, mid ðe mon tyhð, ðæt he ðæt facen mid worhte; ⁊ gif he on þam ordale ful wurðe, dó mon þæt ilce, swa hit ær beforan cwæð.

And if a moneyer is found guilty [of issuing base or light coins] the hand shall be cut off with which he committed the crime, and fastened up on the mint. But if he is accused and he wishes to clear himself, then shall he go the the hot iron [ordeal] and redeem the hand with which he is accused of having committed the crime. And if he is proved guilty the same punishment shall be inflicted as we have already declared.

Gif se mynetere ful wurþe, slea mon ða hand of, ðe þæt ful mid worhte, ⁊ sette ufan on ða minetsmiþan. Gif hit ðonne tyhtle sy, ⁊ he hine ladian wille, ðonne gá he to hatum isene ⁊ ladie ða hand, mid ðæm mon tyhþ, þæt he þæt facn worhte. Gif he ðonne on ðæm ordale ful wurþe, dó man þæt ylce, swa hit her beforan cwyþ.
